items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So Art Tatum recorded with Ben Webster and Roy Eldridge and a lot of other players and myself.

ctx.x: And Norman Granz also put you to together with Tatum, speaking of Tatum.

Yeah, he had decided for a series, which gives a good example of Norman Granz’s thinking about the future and about the archives of music. He put a series of albums together with different players and Art Tatum. So Art Tatum recorded with Ben Webster and Roy Eldridge and a lot of other players and myself. And that was something. That was really intimidating too because I idolized Art Tatum my whole life, from the time I was a kid, and then to be in the studio with Art recording . . .
